description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) PURGATION PUSH (Gravis Linebreaker Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privilege: the Flash Gitz are moved 16" forward (within range of the Eradicators). The Eradicator Squad with Heavy Bolters (GRAVIS, a few inches short of obj_nml_2) shoots the Flash Gitz; unit_has_shot opens; a real click spends 1 CP; the reactive-move panel opens for a normal move of up to 5" that must end within range of an objective; real clicks on Auto-move and Confirm move the unit onto obj_nml_2's range; the unit is then not eligible to declare a charge (cannot_charge) or embark this turn.

steps.comment: setup privilege: the Space Marines player gets the eight WP-M2b detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the other player 0 CP (no stratagem windows not under test)
steps.equals: Terminator Storm Force + Assault Brethren + Gravis Linebreaker Force + Devastator Brethren + Gravis Siege Force + Tactical Brethren + Ironclad Champions + Tacticus Firestorm Force

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
the unit shoots (the shooting panel's unit pick + SHOOT)
the shooter's own unit_selected_to_shoot window (not under test) is declined first
the window's ctx names the unit hit
REAL click (the Space Marines player) on the stratagem's Use button
a normal move of up to 5" that must end within range of an objective
not within range of an objective yet
the unit ended within range of obj_nml_2
not eligible to declare a charge this turn
not eligible to embark this turn
